notes: Sixth Lever tenant, and a C18 union. Oowlish postings are multi-location, and Lever's ?location= filter matches the exact location string, so the tenant's two Costa Rica strings are two separate filter values: 'Costa Rica' covers 1 posting and 'San Jose, San Jose, Costa Rica' covers 2. Filtering by either alone is a partial view, so pre_filter_urls unions both and expected_unfiltered_count=3 equals expected_jobs (the unfiltered board is 13). Derived prefix /oowlish needs no override. This is the doola/REAP shape rather than the Smarsh one: with two competing in-region options, Case B's preference rule has something to re-pick, so hooks.filter_already_applied would not hold. Observed directly on the single-URL config: without pre_filter_urls the agent cleared the filter on 1 of 3 runs and returned the full 13-posting board; with it, 4 of 4 match at 1, and 4 of 4 at 3 after the union was added.
